decision: Retain the DOS 6.0-identical system file table structures and masks.
evidence: The source matches DOS 6.0 and astro byte for byte.
Selected DOS, BIOS and COMMAND sources include sf.inc.
DOS DISK uses sf_mode and sf_flags; its previously compared 1206-byte contribution matches target MSDOS.SYS.
The previous comparison of CONST2, which allocates default SFT entries using SIZE sf_entry, matches 741 aligned data bytes (review 174).
limitations: The prior data comparison includes allocated or uninitialized storage and does not prove every SFT field use. Final link addresses and complete core binary identity remain unverified.
